paragraphs: Thank you. This pilot tests a fictional watch store and several menu layouts. We are checking whether the procedures, menus, and measures are usable before a larger study.

Some tasks were designed to be mildly frustrating, confusing, or boring: the search was built to fail and the categories were deliberately ambiguous. Those feelings were part of the procedure, not a judgement of you. The check-ins and neutral resets were there to bring you back to baseline.
We are studying the interface, not the person: the question is whether different menu layouts work better or worse under different everyday moods.

If you agreed to eye tracking and setup was successful, webcam-based eye tracking was used during the scored search trials. No video, images, audio, or automated emotion detection were stored or inferred. Gaze data are kept in a separate restricted dataset and are pseudonymous. You can withdraw your data now or ask the researcher to remove it later.
If you feel unwell or distressed, please tell the researcher. You can stop at any point. Contact details for support should be inserted here after ethics approval.
This is a pilot build. Ethics approval is required before any real participant takes part.
test_mode_notice: Test mode: timers are shortened. Do not use for real participants.

stop_reasons.participant_stop: You chose to stop the session. Thank you for letting us know.
stop_reasons.distress_at_baseline: The session ended because your check-in indicated a high level of discomfort.
stop_reasons.distress_gt_6: The session ended because your check-in indicated a high level of discomfort.
stop_reasons.distress_during_induction: You let us know that the scenario felt uncomfortable, so the session ended.
stop_reasons.gaze_quality_gate_failed: The session ended because the eye-tracking setup could not meet the study requirements.
stop_reasons.stopped_by_server: The research system ended the session.
stop_reasons.default: The session ended before all activities were completed.

stop_support: The researcher will check on you now. Nothing you did caused a problem.
